input: Build a LAMMPS data file in the class I CVFF-INTERFACE force field (INTERFACE FF 1.5) for an HPEG-type PCE: 8 methallyl-ether PEG side chains of 25 ethylene-oxide units (OH-terminated) copolymerised with 32 acrylic acid units (all deprotonated), side chains evenly spaced, sodium counter-ions. Put the system in a periodic box only slightly larger than the atoms (about 2 Å of empty space on every side).
